_readme: 1. Copy an entry below and change "slug" (used in the URL: /robots/<slug>).
2. Drop photos in public/robots/<slug>/ and list the filenames under "gallery".
3. Set "hero" to the filename of the main photo, or leave it null for a styled placeholder.
Robots render newest-first by the order of this array.
